do_not_touch: 37:6 / 37:3 / 37:7 (DiT, text encoder, audio VAE), 37:10 ConditioningZeroOut for the negative branch, 37:15 latent sized from the encode output, 37:43 switch set to true so decode is TILED — 1536-sample tiles with 64 overlap, which is what keeps a 90 s piece inside the card's memory.

notes.tiled_decode: 37:43 on_true is VAEDecodeAudioTiled. Do not route it to the plain VAEDecodeAudio for long pieces: the graph was built this way because the full decode does not fit.
notes.structure: The captions name sections (intro, main, middle, outro) because the game crossfades between tracks at depth changes, so a cue that resolves at the end sounds deliberate and a cue that ends mid-bar sounds broken.

inputs.caption:
Global Metadata: Dark dungeon ambient score. 68 BPM, D minor with natural and harmonic minor colour. Slow, oppressive and patient throughout, dread that deepens rather than resolves, ending on an unresolved low drone. Instrumental cue for exploring stone corridors.

Vocal Details: Instrumental. No vocals, no humming, no voice of any kind.

Arrangement: Intro: distant low drone and a single sparse struck note with long decay. Main: slow plucked low strings and a bowed cello line in long notes, hand percussion — deep skin drum once every two bars, sparse bells, no backbeat. Middle: the drone thickens, a detuned music-box figure appears high and far, wood creaks and stone resonance in the space. Outro: layers drop away one at a time until only the drone and one last struck note remain, decaying into silence.
